PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Converts inactive grids to station mode to preserve sim speed
PluginData.Description:
Physics on dynamic grids costs the server many times more than on stations. AutoStation converts the grids of players who have been offline for a set time to station mode, on a timer, to help preserve sim speed.
Configure it in Quasar under Server plugins: how often it runs, how long owners must be offline, a minimum distance from online players, and whether grids in gravity, subgrids and unowned grids are included. Grid tracking leaves grids that are still moving alone, so players can use a team mate's grid while its owner is offline.
Commands: !AS About, !AS ForceRun (moderators), !AS ForceAll_ADMIN [smallGrids] [subGrids] (admins).
Also available as a Torch plugin, both builds share the same code.
